translation: Atziri, Atziri, black there buried Vaal!
notes: Atziri proper name (no dict hit). ek: Yucatec EK' black (Cordemex; apostrophe optional; folded lemma longer than EK wasp). Competitors: EK' star, brazilwood, grease; EK wasp; K'iche' ek go. Tie-break length then Random(55555) among EK' senses -> black. te: Yucatec locative particle (grammar te'la here / te'lo there; ilide te'elo' yonder). TE head competitors: cacao-counter, inviter, temptation (Random among TE heads would pick cacao-counter; surrounding deictics le/ti' bound locative). mucane: Yucatec MUK bury + attested suffix -ane (c=k same /k/); competitor MUK hide. Vaal proper name (no dict hit). Strict on ek/te/muk; mucane compound medium.

Teoyuxtlane: Nahuatl teo- holy/god combining form (teoyohtica holy; toteotzin our Lord; teocalli church) + -tlan(e) locative (itlan under; itzintlan). Residue yux unexplained; not Gate 1. ascensionada: Spanish feminine participle of ascension (Romance abstract loan; not an ilide head). Yutsal: no exact hit; split yut|sal has Cordemex YUT bezoar and SAL toponym, not a clean compound. Opaque remainder kept.

translation: Atziri, Atziri, do not kilya Zerphi!
notes: ma: Yucatec MA' not (Cordemex negative particle; ilide no : ma'). Longer than MA command-with-force. kilya: no strict exact. Soft Nahuatl (qui-)ilia tell (iliaya I was telling him; oquilih he said it to him). Residue y/i; not Gate 1. Zerphi proper name; /ph/ flags possible Spanish, no hit. Translation keeps kilya if the tell reading is refused.

translation: At itsok anab all-ra! Kextal xi kujkuali ik'bala!
notes: Ti: Yucatec TI' in/at/to (Cordemex locative adverb). itsok: no attested root (splits it|sok goma/caracol and its|ok goma/foot are noise). anab: strict miss; loose Yucatec unab entirely (a~u forbidden). nochira: Nahuatl nochi all (wordlist) + residue ra (soft). Kextal: Yucatec KEX where/although + TAL appear/manifest (compound with no single-language affix covering all). xi: Yucatec XI obscure head (palette first); Nahuatl xi year competitor. kujkuali: Nahuatl cualli/cuali good with unexplained kuj (cuahcualli is a near form, extra a). ik'bala: Yucatec IK' breath/wind (ilide iik' wind) + bala unexplained. Line mostly opaque; function word Ti only.
ikba'yucane: no exact hit. Shares -ane with mucane (Maya suffix) but ikba' and yucane lack attested roots covering the surface. IK' wind does not account for ba'yucane. No invented root.

translation: You-there Ibil tlayeb brush! You-there bug tlayeb kifba!
notes: A'te: Yucatec A 2sg + te locative/presentative (you-there). 'Ibil: Yucatec IBIL shake (strict exact). Competitor EBIL ladder needs e~i, forbidden. May also be a name. tlayeb: no exact; tla- Nahuatl unspecified-object prefix + yeb (Cordemex yeb ladder) is a cross-graft, forbidden. Left opaque. kutsen: Yucatec KUTS + -en (same-language affix, Gate 1). Random(55555) among KUTS senses -> brush-clean; competitor turkey/pavo. ik'el: Yucatec ik'el bug/bicho (ilide; strict exact). Competitors IK'IL aerial and IK'AL breathe need vowel change. kifba: contains /f/ so Spanish-flagged; no Spanish head. Opaque.
ascenada: Spanish ascended (same Romance stem as ascensionada, shortened). akal: Yucatec AKAL approach (strict exact). Competitor AKAL clothes-tear. Random(55555) -> approach.

translation: Aiokmo honorable xu'te! Aiokmo abundant jare elba!
notes: Aiokmo: no attached-dict hit (Classical ayocmo not in the packet lexicons; cannot cite it). til: Yucatec TIL honorable/venerable (strict). xu'te: strict miss; loose Nawat xuta to wound / xuti water-snail (vowel change). jare: /r/ flags K'iche'; no jare head (jarik to cost is not jare). elba: strict miss; loose Spanish/Yucatec alba dawn or soften wax. tul: Yucatec TUL abundant/full (Random among TUL: abundance-full; competitors person-numeral, sores). Line remains mostly opaque.

Kuxte': Yucatec KUX live/life (Cordemex; ilide kuxtal life) + te' (TE' plant or locative te'). Compound, same language. Competitor Nawat kuxta cacao-like tree (loose vowel). kíimil': Yucatec kíimil/KIMIL death/dead (ilide muerte : kíimil; Cordemex cosa muerta). Strict exact. Pair life vs death is from neighboring attested tokens, not from an English prior.

Tlaxye': no exact. Nahuatl tlaxcalli tortilla is a longer different lemma (residue). Left opaque. le: Yucatec LE demonstrative that/the (Cordemex ese/aquel; ilide ese : lelo'). Random among LE heads -> demonstrative; competitor lasso. Surrounding name Vaal bounds article reading. Vaal name.
Ma'oxe: MA' not + oxe (OX Cordemex several heads; residue e). Not full coverage. ik'el: Yucatec bug (strict).
le'itzil: no exact. Possible le' the + itzil (ITZIL not headed in Cordemex extract). Left opaque. No invented itzil root.
Xatlene: no hit. kujkuali: Nahuatl cuali/cualli good with kuj residue; not Gate 1.

Gyan'uks: initial /g/ Nahuatl diagnostic (silent g). Remainder yan matches Yucatec YAN there-is/have, but -uks is an unlicensed romanization tail under strict (TIGHTENED_LATITUDE forbids free -uks drop). ko'janti: no hit.
A'te: A 2sg + te presentative. 'Ibil: IBIL shake, or a vocative name. Strict on both pieces.
A'te as in 15. ik'el: Yucatec ik'el bug (strict). If a name, keep ik'el; gloss stands.
Yaxe: no strict exact. ilide ya'ax green / yáax first; residue e. chikula': Yucatec chikul (insignia/sign/silence) + residue a (soft). CHIKILA' toponym needs i~u, forbidden.
Tzokan'te: no exact (TSOK pull-out/punish + -an + te is speculative residue). ik'el bug.
A'te as above. líimek: no exact. Splits lii|mek (li moon + mek crooked) and lim|ek do not cover the whole form without leftover.
Yatle: ya (Yucatec afflicted) + Nahuatl tle climb (CN tle koltia) or tletl fire; cross-graft if mixed. yutsal/Yutsal: no clean hit.
tlayeb opaque (see line 6). kutsen: KUTS+en brush-clean (turkey competitor).
Both tokens lack a strict full-coverage root. kifba /f/ Spanish-flagged miss.

U'Te: Yucatec U 3sg possessive/person (u kuxtal his life) + te presentative (he-there / here-is). kuxkal: KUX live + KAL (many Cordemex heads: enclosure, throat, etc.). Name-like compound. Same-language segmentation.
A'te as above. yuquia: K'iche' yuq stretch out, residue ia (soft). Nahuatl yuhqui thus is a near form (h leftover).
Eche: strict miss; loose Yucatec ACHE oh/poor (e~a forbidden). lu: strict miss. nochbe: NOCH gourd + BE road (residue on NOCH; be camino is attested). No whole-token exact.
Kí': Yucatec KI' (strict). Random(55555) among KI' senses -> better. Competitors: wine, delicious, soft-to-touch, drunk. K'iche' ki' sweet is corroborating not competing sense-class. inib: no hit.

translation: Ayok, I am angered, his mujuk' the buried-one, niáach i'chian.
notes: 'Ayok: no hit (same stem-shape as Aiokmo). ta': Yucatec TA' (Random -> anger-other; competitors gluttony, beetle). Palette Yucatec over K'iche' ta' ask. en: Yucatec -EN / EN 1sg I am (Cordemex). u: Yucatec U 3sg his/her/its. mujuk': no exact (K'iche' muj semi-dark + uk leftover). le: the. mucane: MUK+ane bury. niáach: NACH far/foreign is shorter; extra ia not an affix. i'chian: ICH eye/in + leftover ian. Partial only.

A'te: you-there. waja: no exact (WA interrogative + ha, or WAH bread, leftovers). yatle: see 20. u'tra: /r/ K'iche' or Spanish otra; no exact (ultra not in lexicons). buxa: Yucatec BUX small gourd + a leftover (soft).
A'te: you-there. fukuur: /f/ Spanish-flagged; no furor/fuego/fuerza head matches the surface (furor lacks k and uu). Opaque.
Xi: Yucatec XI (palette); Nahuatl xi year competitor. daka: /d/ Spanish-flagged; no daca/daga head. puxe: strict miss; loose K'iche' puxa perhaps (e~a forbidden).

'Ayok opaque. kifba /f/ opaque. kilya soft tell (see 3). sakilja: Yucatec sakil whiteness (Cordemex blancura) + ja ~ ha' water (j/h in dict_lookup variants; HA' water). Same-language compound, small orthographic step. Gloss white-water / whiteness-water.
Ik'eche: IK' wind/breath + eche leftover; not full coverage. sakilja as in 31. atla: strict miss; loose ATLE (a~e forbidden). donuks: no strict; Spanish don + unlicensed -uks tail. Opaque.
No strict roots. ko' may be Yucatec KO tooth/notch, leftover soxsal. soxsal no hit.
ko'mujuk: ko' + mujuk; mujuk' also on line 27, still no exact root.

translation: xi he-there cha'tsoke, you-there itsok chief yotlapek the the Vaal te'moxti qexcan...
notes: Xi: see 30. u'te: U 3sg + te (he-there). cha'tsoke: no exact; Yucatec CH'A take vs cha' (glottal site differs); TSOK punish / TS'OK finish are competitors with leftover e. a'te: you-there. itsok opaque. xefe: Spanish jefe chief (ilide jefe; dict_lookup exact via x~j while /f/ present). yotlapek: yo + tlapek; Nahuatl tlapechtia serve as base / Pipil tapech frame-bed, residue yo and k/ch. le le: Yucatec LE the/that doubled. Vaal name. te'moxti: Nahuatl temo descend (Campbell CN bajar) + residue xti (soft). qexcan: no hit; -can Nahuatl place suffix would leave qex.
Na': Yucatec na' mother (Cordemex; ilide madre). Longer than NA house. K'iche' na' feel/taste is a competitor (palette Yucatec first). puyao: no hit. Opaque second token.

translation: In tlapec he-there puyao, you-there itsok pu crushed ta'nuk!
notes: Ich: Yucatec ICH. Random among ICH senses -> eye. Surrounding u'te locative frame bounds locative ICH in/inside (ilide en/dentro : ich, ichil); eye/face/fruit logged as competitors. tlapec: Nahuatl/Pipil tlapech bed/frame (tapech; tlapechtia), leftover/h. u'te: he-there. puyao opaque. a'te: you-there. itsok opaque. pu: Yucatec pu (palette; dump camada). K'iche' pu edge/mouth competitor. uch': Yucatec UCH' crushed/flattened (longer than UCH long-ago). ta'nuk: strict soft TANU to-the-moon + k; loose TANAK callus / TANOK sole-of-foot.
Otsuks: Yucatec OTS several heads + unlicensed -uks tail; OTSOK slacken-pace is near, leftover s. Tzokan'te opaque (see 18). u'te ik'el: he-there bug.
Proper name; repeated vocative. No dictionary root; identity is the surface name.

translation: You-there Kuxkal tlayeb brush. Ela tlayeb ukto! Who that at a'tul?
notes: A'te Kuxkal: you-there + KUX+KAL name-like (see 23). tlayeb opaque. kutsen brush-clean (turkey competitor). Ela: strict miss; Yucatec EL burn + leftover a (soft). ukto: no strict (Nahuatl ocotl pine-torch would need o~u and tl drop, both forbidden). Máax: Yucatec máax who (Cordemex grammar maax quien; ilide quién : máax). High. ka: Yucatec KA' that/when/if/and/two. Interrogative frame Máax ka ti bounds KA' that/which over Random's if. ti: TI' at/to. a'tul: strict miss; loose ATAL paid/rewarded (a~a length only if a'tul~atul apostrophe); also A 2sg + TUL full.
Proper name vocative, as line 39.

Máax ka ti: who that at. cheyel: no exact (che wood/anuncio + yel leftover). Left opaque.

Axba: Yucatec AX throw-down + BA reflexive (Cordemex BA reciprocal/reflexive). Speculative compound, leftover none if accepted; AX also guitar/other. Kíibsa': KIB wax/candle + sa leftover; no exact. ta' en: TA' anger-other + EN I-am (see 27).

Ti: TI' at. ek: EK' black (star competitor; same tie-break as line 1). tala: strict miss; loose Spanish tela cloth (e~a forbidden). jare'yantul: jare' /r/ K'iche' miss + YAN there-is/have + TUL person/full. Segmented tail only; jare' stays opaque.

Ti': Yucatec TI' in/at/to (strict exact, locative). ek'le: EK' black + LE the/that (same-language compound; star competitor on EK'). upulché: Yucatec UPUL be-opposed/resisted + attested Maya suffix -che (dict_lookup affix, no residue). Competitor CHE' wood as a free word rather than suffix.
